name: SD.cpp Studio style templates
description: Style templates for generation. Each style has just two fields: prompt and negative_prompt. In prompt, use the {prompt} placeholder where your own prompt should go; if you omit it, the template is simply prepended to your prompt. The negative_prompt is appended to your negative prompt. Edit this file to add, change, or remove styles.

styles.name: Cinematic
styles.prompt: cinematic lighting, film still, dramatic composition, {prompt}, shallow depth of field, 35mm
styles.negative_prompt: lowres, blurry, jpeg artifacts, watermark, text

styles.name: Anime
styles.prompt: in style of anime, vibrant colors, cel shading, {prompt}, detailed lineart, studio quality

styles.name: Photorealistic
styles.prompt: photorealistic, highly detailed, sharp focus, natural lighting, 8k uhd, {prompt}
styles.negative_prompt: cartoon, painting, sketch, blurry, lowres, artifacts

styles.name: Cyberpunk
styles.prompt: cyberpunk, neon lights, futuristic city, rain, reflections, night scene, {prompt}

styles.name: Watercolor
styles.prompt: watercolor painting, soft edges, flowing pigments, paper texture, {prompt}, loose brushstrokes
styles.negative_prompt: photorealistic, sharp lines, digital art, blurry, watermark

styles.name: Minimalist
styles.prompt: minimalist, clean composition, negative space, soft gradient background, {prompt}
